entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker and ancient vampire, grandson of Edgar Markov, who created Avacyn to protect the humans of his homeworld Innistrad.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, an alchemist who created the first vampires of Innistrad through a blood ritual and still lives in Markov Manor.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: A demon who preyed on Edgar Markov's ambition and whispered the secrets of his blood-feeding experiment.

entities.name: Avacyn
aliases: the angelic champion of the meek
entities.description: An angel created by Sorin to protect Innistrad's humans; she has disappeared.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's home plane, whose balance between humans and monsters has collapsed with Avacyn's disappearance.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The home of the Markov family, where Edgar still lives and Sorin is not welcome.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city whose walls are besieged by ghouls.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: The land where Edgar Markov was an alchemist before vampires existed.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that grew up around the power Sorin invested in Avacyn.

events.summary: Edgar Markov, an alchemist in Stensia, performs a blood ritual during a famine, creating the first vampires of Innistrad.
events.quote: Thousands of years ago, before there were vampires on Innistrad, Edgar Markov was an alchemist in the land that would become Stensia.

events.summary: The demon Shilgengar encourages Edgar's blood experiment, which Edgar wanted to achieve agelessness for himself and Sorin.
events.quote: A demon called Shilgengar preyed on Edgar's ambition and whispered secrets that would point the way toward Edgar's blood-feeding experiment.

events.summary: Edgar anoints Sorin with the vampiric state and Sorin vanishes, his planeswalker spark ignited by the trauma.
events.quote: The trauma of the transformation had caused Sorin's planeswalker spark to ignite.

events.summary: Sorin sees vampires dwindling the human villages and creates the angel Avacyn to protect Innistrad, giving rise to the Church of Avacyn.
events.quote: He created an angel he named Avacyn and tasked her with protecting the plane.

events.summary: Most vampires revile Sorin as a traitor for creating Avacyn and he is no longer welcome at Markov Manor.
events.quote: Some of the vampires understood Sorin's act, but most reviled him as a traitor.

events.summary: Avacyn disappears from Innistrad, upsetting the balance between humans and monsters.
events.quote: But now Avacyn has disappeared from Innistrad.

events.summary: Sorin returns to Innistrad to find vampires killing at will, werewolves preying on cathars, and ghouls besieging Thraben, and draws his sword.
events.quote: the ancient vampire draws his sword under the light of a grim moon.

relations.quote: created Avacyn, the angelic champion of the meek and divine source of the protective power on Innistrad.

relations.note: anointed Sorin with the vampiric state
relations.quote: He anointed Sorin with the same vampiric state

The Church of Avacyn grew up around the power Sorin invested in her.
